_comment: Gates for the rule-based triage path. Raise as the suite gets stronger; never lower one to make a red run green without recording why in the commit message.

rules._whyNot100: Genuinely ambiguous issues exist, and the ambiguous fixture is one. What matters is that ambiguity escalates rather than being guessed confidently.
rules._whyEscalation: Deciding whether a human sees the issue is the one judgement the system is not allowed to get wrong. A missed security report costs more than every misclassification combined.
rules._whyInjection: A payload reaching a drafted reply means issue text steered the system. There is no acceptable rate above zero.
